info.title: SE-Path 学伴 API
info.description: Machine-readable contract for the SE-Path software-engineering learning companion. The browser only sends pseudonymous learning evidence; API keys, raw logs and real student identifiers stay outside the public package.

parameters.name: x-hub-signature-256
parameters.description: Recommended GitHub HMAC-SHA256 signature over the raw JSON body, formatted as sha256=<hex>.

parameters.name: x-github-delivery
parameters.description: GitHub delivery ID used for audit and troubleshooting.

parameters.name: x-github-event
parameters.description: GitHub event name, such as workflow_run or pull_request.

parameters.name: x-sepath-webhook-token
parameters.description: Legacy shared-token fallback for existing SE-Path Actions snippets. Prefer x-hub-signature-256 for production pilots.

get.summary: Read the teacher assistant conversation and server-built evidence context.
get.description: Returns the latest scoped conversation. The server, not the browser, assembles pseudonymous work-order evidence for grounding.

parameters.name: workOrderId
parameters.description: When omitted, the assistant works at course scope and must not invent learner-level diagnosis.

200.description: Conversation history and the current evidence context

post.summary: Send a teacher question to the governed course assistant.
post.description: The request contains only a teacher question and idempotency key. Evidence, student returns and prior review records are read by the backend.

200.description: Idempotent replay of a saved assistant turn

post.summary: Convert a grounded assistant turn into a teacher-editable task draft.
post.description: Prepares a draft only. It never publishes a student task, closes a work order, changes scores or writes a final evaluation.

200.description: Teacher-editable draft prepared from the selected assistant turn

SepathTokenIssuer.name: x-sepath-token-issuer-secret
SepathTokenIssuer.description: Server-side issuer credential used only by trusted deployment tooling.

ReturnToken.name: returnToken
ReturnToken.description: Teacher-issued student return token. It only opens the scoped student return view after a teacher review decision exists.

Unauthorized.description: Missing, malformed, expired or invalid SE-Path token

Forbidden.description: Role or learner scope is not allowed

BadRequest.description: Request shape or required fields are invalid

PrivacyBlocked.description: Protected field or non-pseudonymous learner identifier was blocked

ModelUnavailable.description: Model is unavailable and deterministic fallback was explicitly disabled

NotReady.description: Cloud runtime is missing required configuration

revision.description: Number of teacher return-for-evidence cycles already requested.

teacherEdited.description: Whether the package was published from a teacher-confirmed editable draft.

InterventionPackageDraft.description: Teacher-editable package draft. Empty fields fall back to the safe system proposal; direct-answer boundaries are re-applied by the server.

returnToken.description: Teacher-visible student return token. Reviewer, student and ledger-export responses remove this field.

CourseMicroTaskPackage.description: Teacher-approved class micro-task package generated from shared evidence gaps. It is published into target work-order ledgers and keeps AI suggestions inside a formative, non-direct-answer boundary.

CourseTeachingImprovementItem.description: One teacher-confirmed next-round teaching improvement action derived from course intervention review or repeated evidence gaps.

CourseTeachingImprovementPlan.description: Teacher-confirmed course-level improvement plan. It records formative teaching adjustments only and must not be used for ranking, punishment or automatic high-risk decisions.

CourseTeachingImprovementExecutionReceip.description: Teacher execution receipt for a previously published course-level teaching improvement plan. It proves course action execution only and must not be used for learner ranking, punishment or automatic evaluation.

CourseTeachingImprovementFollowupSample.description: Next-round sampling plan after a teacher-executed teaching improvement. It records observation criteria only and must not be treated as causal proof or automatic learner evaluation.

CourseTeachingImprovementFollowupResult.description: Collected next-round observation results after a sampling plan. It records evidence changes only and must not be treated as causal proof or automatic learner evaluation.

CourseResourceRevisionTicket.description: Teacher-confirmed course resource revision ticket derived from follow-up observations. It updates teaching resources and evidence criteria only; it does not rank, punish or automatically evaluate learners.

CourseResourceReleaseReceipt.description: Teacher-confirmed release receipt proving a revised course resource version was published to course channels. It records delivery, checks and rollback only; it does not claim causal teaching impact, rank, punish or automatically evaluate learners.

CourseResourceUsageReceipt.description: Teacher-confirmed usage receipt for a revised course resource. It records usage signals, evidence return and review readiness only; it is not causal proof, learner ranking, punishment or automatic evaluation.

usageReceiptId.description: The teacher-confirmed resource usage receipt id that must already be present in the ledger.

traceId.description: Stable reminder trace id used to prevent duplicate reminder ledger entries.
The course micro-task trace to remind against.

returnToken.description: Teacher-issued token required for link-based student return when no verified student session is present.

StudentReturnArtifact.description: Structured student evidence package for teacher review. It records evidence and reflection inputs, not directly submit-ready answers.

TeacherEvidenceReviewPayload.description: Teacher-side evidence review saved before final acceptance. AI can only provide candidates; the teacher records the review decision.

sourceLedgerEntryId.description: Ledger id of the learner evidence return being reviewed.

learnerAlias.description: Optional pseudonymous display label, not a real student identifier.

ciLogSummary.description: Redacted summary only; raw logs are forbidden by x-sepath-boundaries.

learnerAlias.description: Optional pseudonymous display label, not a real student identifier.

ciLogSummary.description: Redacted summary only; raw logs are forbidden by x-sepath-boundaries.

authMode.description: Webhook authentication mode. Present for webhook imports.

deliveryId.description: Webhook delivery ID when supplied by the caller.

githubEvent.description: GitHub event header when supplied by the caller.

workOrderId.description: Required for a scoped student return token.

accessCode.description: Teacher console access code verified only on the server.

accessToken.description: Short-lived HMAC token. It must not be persisted in browser localStorage.

learnerAlias.description: Pseudonymous classroom label such as SE-0321; not a real student name.

repositoryUser.description: Optional Git platform username after classroom privacy review.

learnerAlias.description: Optional pseudonymous display label, not a real student identifier.

ciLogSummary.description: Redacted summary only; raw logs are forbidden by x-sepath-boundaries.

deliveryId.description: Webhook delivery id used as the idempotency key when provided.

interpretation.description: Formative interpretation only; it is not a causal uplift claim or ranking signal.

citations.description: Only collected evidence ids from AgentContext.evidence may be cited.

x-sepath-boundaries.claimBoundary: This contract proves runnable API shape and privacy gates for pseudonymous learning records. Real course learning uplift still requires teacher-confirmed pilot telemetry and authorized data collection.
